resources.string: Hide Premium promotions
Hides Get Music Premium in the account menu and settings.
Block video ads
Skips ads before and between songs.
Reseam settings entry
Adds Reseam Settings to YouTube Music\'s settings.
Save to device
Saves downloaded songs and playlists as audio files in a folder you choose.
Unlock downloads
Downloads songs, albums and playlists without Premium.
Hide action buttons
Hides chosen buttons below the player.
Hide category bar
Hides the mood and genre chips above feeds.
Force portrait
Keeps the app in portrait when you rotate your phone.
Hide buttons
Hides the cast, search, history and activity buttons.
Hide layout components
Hides the Speed dial shelf and chosen parts of the player.
Hide menu items
Hides chosen items of the long-press and three-dot menus.
Miniplayer skip buttons
Adds previous and next buttons to the miniplayer.
Navigation bar
Hides chosen tabs of the navigation bar.
Hide settings menu items
Hides chosen rows of YouTube Music\'s settings.
Start in miniplayer
Keeps a new song in the miniplayer instead of opening the full player.
Start page
Opens a page of your choice instead of Home.
Theme
Replaces the black background with a color of your choice.
Background color
The color that replaces the black background, as #AARRGGBB.
Clean share links
Removes tracking from the links you share.
Fix playback
Makes videos play when YouTube Music blocks the app.
Spoof user agent
Reports the original app in requests, so YouTube Music accepts them.
Audio-only playback
Unlocks Don\'t play music videos, which plays songs without their video.
Background playback
Keeps playing in the background and with the screen off.
Force original audio
Plays the original audio instead of a dubbed track.
Playback speed
Plays every song at the speed you choose.
SponsorBlock
Skips the parts of music videos that are not music, as marked by the SponsorBlock community.
